import pychrono.vehicle as veh
import math

chrono.SetChronoDataPath(chrono.GetChronoDataPath())
veh.SetDataPath(chrono.GetChronoDataPath() + 'vehicle/')

initRot = chrono.ChQuaterniond(1, 0, 0, 0)

terrainLength = 100.0  # size in X direction
terrainWidth = 100.0   # size in Y direction

# Poon chassis tracked by the camera

# Contact method
contact_method = chrono.ChContactMethod_NSC
contact_vis = False

# Simulation step sizes
step_size = 1e-3
tire_step_size = step_size

# Time interval between two render frames
render_step_size = 1.0 / 50  # FPS = 50


# Create the HMMWV vehicle, set parameters, and initialize

vehicle.SetContactMethod(contact_method)
vehicle.SetChassisCollisionType(chassis_collision_type)

vis.SetWindowSize(1280, 1024)
vis.SetChaseCamera(trackPoint, 6.0, 0.5)

vis.AddSkyBox()

# Set the time response for steering and throttle keyboard inputs.

throttle_time = 1.0  # time to go from 0 to +1
braking_time = 0.3   # time to go from 0 to +1
driver.SetSteeringDelta(render_step_size / steering_time)
driver.SetThrottleDelta(render_step_size / throttle_time)
driver.SetBrakingDelta(render_step_size / braking_time)

driver.Initialize()

# output vehicle mass
print( "VEHICLE MASS: ",  vehicle.GetVehicle().GetMass())

# Number of simulation steps between miscellaneous events
render_steps = math.ceil(render_step_size / step_size)

# Initialize simulation frame counter s
realtime_timer = chrono.ChRealtimeStepTimer()
step_number = 0
render_frame = 0

while vis.Run() :
    time = vehicle.GetSystem().GetChTime()

    # Render scene and output POV-Ray data
    if (step_number % render_steps == 0) :
        vis.BeginScene()
        vis.Render()
        vis.EndScene()
        render_frame += 1

    # Get driver inputs
    driver_inputs = driver.GetInputs()

    # Update modules (process inputs from other modules)
    driver.Synchronize(time)
    terrain.Synchronize(time)
    vehicle.Synchronize(time, driver_inputs, terrain)
    vis.Synchronize(time, driver_inputs)

    # Advance simulation for one timestep for all modules
    driver.Advance(step_size)
    terrain.Advance(step_size)
    vehicle.Advance(step_size)
    vis.Advance(step_size)

    # Increment frame number
    step_number += 1

    # Spin in place for real time to catch up
    realtime_timer.Spin(step_size)

import pychrono as chrono
import pychrono.vehicle as veh
import pychrono.irrlicht as irr

# Initialize the PyChrono environment
chrono.SetChronoDataPath("/path/to/chrono/data/")

init_rot = chrono.ChQuaternionD(1, 0, 0, 0)

vehicle.SetContactMethod(contact_method)

# Set the tire model
tire_model = veh.TireModelType_TMEASY
vehicle.SetTireType(tire_model)

# Set other vehicle parameters

vehicle.SetInitFwdVel(0.0)

# Initialize the vehicle

# Use primitive visualization for the vehicle components
vehicle.SetChassisVisualizationType(veh.VisualizationType_PRIMITIVES)
vehicle.SetSuspensionVisualizationType(veh.VisualizationType_PRIMITIVES)
vehicle.SetSteeringVisualizationType(veh.VisualizationType_PRIMITIVES)
vehicle.SetWheelVisualizationType(veh.VisualizationType_NONE)
vehicle.SetTireVisualizationType(veh.VisualizationType_MESH)

# Create the terrain
terrain = veh.RigidTerrain(vehicle.GetSystem())
patch_mat = chrono.ChMaterialSurfaceNSC()
patch_mat.SetFriction(0.9)
patch_mat.SetRestitution(0.01)

patch.SetTexture(veh.GetDataFile("terrain/textures/tile4.jpg"), 200, 200)
patch.SetColor(chrono.ChColor(0.8, 0.8, 0.5))
terrain.Initialize()

# Create the Irrlicht application
vis = veh.ChWheeledVehicleVisualSystemIrrlicht()
vis.SetWindowTitle('HMMWV')
vis.SetWindowSize(1280, 720)
vis.SetChaseCamera(chrono.ChVectorD(0.0, 0.0, 1.75), 6.0, 0.5)
vis.Initialize()
vis.AddLogo(chrono.GetChronoDataFile('logo_pychrono_alpha.png'))
vis.AddLightDirectional()
vis.AddSkyBox()
vis.AttachVehicle(vehicle.GetVehicle())

# Create the interactive driver system
driver = veh.ChIrrGuiDriver(vis)
driver.SetSteeringDelta(0.02)
driver.SetThrottleDelta(0.02)
driver.SetBrakingDelta(0.06)
driver.Initialize()

# Simulation loop
while vis.Run():
    time = vehicle.GetSystem().GetChTime()
    driver_inputs = driver.GetInputs()
    vehicle.Advance(time - vehicle.GetSystem().GetChTime())
    vis.Advance(driver_inputs)
    vis.Render()
    vehicle.GetSystem().DoStepDynamics(1 / 50.0)

path_ball1_asset = chrono.ChSphereShape(1)
path_ball1_asset.SetColor(chrono.ChColor(1, 0, 0))
path_ball1.AddAsset(path_ball1_asset)
path_ball1.SetPosition(path_points[0])
vis.GetSceneManager().getRootSceneNode().addChild(path_ball1)

path_ball2 = irr.ChIrrNodeAsset.new(vis.GetSceneManager().getRootSceneNode())
path_ball2_asset = chrono.ChSphereShape(1)
path_ball2_asset.SetColor(chrono.ChColor(0, 1, 0))
path_ball2.AddAsset(path_ball2_asset)
path_ball2.SetPosition(path_points[num_path_points//2])
vis.GetSceneManager().getRootSceneNode().addChild(path_ball2)

# Create a path-follower driver
driver = veh.ChPathFollowerDriver(vehicle.GetVehicle(), path_points, path_radius * 2 * math.pi, 5.0)
driver.SetColor(chrono.ChColor(0, 0, 1))  # Set color for sentinel and target points
driver.Initialize()

# Set constant throttle value
throttle_value = 0.3

# PID gains for steering control
steering_PID_gains = chrono.ChVector3d(0.5, 0, 0)  # P, I, D gains
driver.GetSteeringController().SetGains(steering_PID_gains.x, steering_PID_gains.y, steering_PID_gains.z)

# Number of simulation steps between miscellaneous events
render_steps = math.ceil(render_step_size / step_size)

# Initialize simulation frame counter
realtime_timer = chrono.ChRealtimeStepTimer()
step_number = 0
render_frame = 0

while vis.Run() :
    time = vehicle.GetSystem().GetChTime()

    # Render scene and output POV-Ray data
    if (step_number % render_steps == 0) :
        vis.BeginScene()
        vis.Render()
        vis.EndScene()
        render_frame += 1

    # Get driver inputs
    driver_inputs = veh.DriverInputs()
    driver_inputs.m_throttle = throttle_value
    driver_inputs.m_steering = driver.GetSteering()

    # Update modules (process inputs from other modules)
    driver.Synchronize(time)
    terrain.Synchronize(time)
    vehicle.Synchronize(time, driver_inputs, terrain)
    vis.Synchronize(time, driver_inputs)

    # Visualize sentinel and target points
    sentinel = driver.GetSteeringController().GetSentinelLocation()
    target = driver.GetSteeringController().GetTargetLocation()
    sentinel_node = vis.GetSceneManager().getSceneNodeFromName('sentinel')
    if sentinel_node is None:
        sentinel_node = vis.GetSceneManager().addSphereSceneNode(0.5)
        sentinel_node.setName('sentinel')
    sentinel_node.setPosition(irr.vector3df(sentinel.x, sentinel.y, sentinel.z))
    target_node = vis.GetSceneManager().getSceneNodeFromName('target')
    if target_node is None:
        target_node = vis.GetSceneManager().addSphereSceneNode(0.5)
        target_node.setName('target')
    target_node.setPosition(irr.vector3df(target.x, target.y, target.z))

    # Advance simulation for one timestep for all modules
    driver.Advance(step_size)
    terrain.Advance(step_size)
    vehicle.Advance(step_size)
    vis.Advance(step_size)

    # Increment frame number
    step_number += 1

    # Spin in place for real time to catch up
    realtime_timer.Spin(step_size)
